name: Access0x1MemberFeeHook
description: A merchant's dynamic-fee pool where its members pay a lower swap fee. The merchant, registered on the Access0x1 Router, names any membership contract and tier, a member fee and a public fee, capped at 10%. A swapper with an active membership pays the member fee; anyone else, or any failed read, pays the public fee. No funds, no admin.

reasons: Dynamic fee: Uniswap's router needs a manual allowlist for dynamic-fee hooks, which only applies on mainnet.
Deployed addresses start 0x8D/0x40/0xd8, 0x35/0x82/0x37 and 0x47/0x49/0x70: none starts 0x91.

pool.binding: Each PoolId is bound to the first merchant that configures it; only that merchant's current owner can change it.
pool.fee: Dynamic only; static-fee pools are refused at initialize.

math.formula: fee = member ? memberFee : publicFee, returned with OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG (0x400000)

deltas.settledBy: Nobody; only the LP fee changes.

externalCalls.trust: Chosen by the merchant. Gas-capped, try/catch: failure means the public fee.
Chosen by the merchant. Gas-capped, try/catch.
Read only in configure and setRouterTrust.

accessControl.caller: the merchant's current owner on the Router

securityAssumptions: The merchant's chosen membership contract and routers answer truthfully; a wrong answer affects only that merchant's pool fee.
doesNotGuarantee: Does not stop the first configurer of an unopened PoolId from binding it: a merchant whose PoolId is taken picks another tick spacing.
The merchant can change fees at any time, up to 10%.
Does not discount members who swap through a router the merchant has not trusted.

invariants.statement: The hook's address carries exactly beforeInitialize and beforeSwap, mask 0x2080.
A member pays less than an outsider for the same swap.
For any amount and fees, a member never receives less than an outsider.
An untrusted router's user pays the public fee.
A failing membership contract means the public fee and a settled swap.
Only the merchant's owner configures, and a configured pool cannot move to another merchant.
Unconfigured and static-fee pools cannot be initialised.
